const pct = (n, d) => +(100 * n / d).toFixed(3);
const {baseline: b, shadow: s, general: g} = opening;
const sum = (o, k) => Object.values(o.shadowSlotByteOffsets).reduce((t, r) => t + r[k], 0);
const r = {
  sameSource: new Set([b, s, g].map(x => x.sourceSHA)).size === 1,
  sameOutput: new Set([b, s, g].map(x => x.outputSHA)).size === 1,
  slotLoads: [b, s, g].map(x => sum(x, "loads")), slotStores: [b, s, g].map(x => sum(x, "stores")),
  slotsIdentical: JSON.stringify(b.shadowSlotByteOffsets) === JSON.stringify(g.shadowSlotByteOffsets) && JSON.stringify(b.shadowSlotByteOffsets) === JSON.stringify(s.shadowSlotByteOffsets),
  shadowBodySaved: b.shadow.steps - s.shadow.steps,
  shadowSaved: b.fullFrameSteps - s.fullFrameSteps,
  generalSaved: b.fullFrameSteps - g.fullFrameSteps,
  generalExtra: s.fullFrameSteps - g.fullFrameSteps,
  calleeRemoved: b.absTotalSteps - s.absTotalSteps,
  shadowPct: pct(b.fullFrameSteps - s.fullFrameSteps, b.fullFrameSteps),
  generalPct: pct(b.fullFrameSteps - g.fullFrameSteps, b.fullFrameSteps),
  bodyPct: pct(b.shadow.steps - s.shadow.steps, b.shadow.steps),
  perCall: (b.shadow.steps - s.shadow.steps) / b.shadow.absCalls,
  calleePerCall: b.absTotalSteps / b.shadow.absCalls,
  callerPerSiteNet: (b.shadow.steps - s.shadow.steps)/b.shadow.absCalls,
  bytes: [b, s, g].map(x => [x.imageBytes, x.shadowBytes]),
  unchanged: ["directStackLoads", "directStackStores", "boundsTests"].every(k => b.shadow[k] === g.shadow[k] && b.shadow[k] === s.shadow[k]),
  forecastOld: measured.hypothetical.predictedFullFrameReductionPercent,
  forecastOnCurrent: pct(measured.hypothetical.savedRetired, b.fullFrameSteps),
  ceilingOld: pct(measured.observed.stackLoads - measured.observed.calls, measured.observed.frameRetired),
  ceilingCurrent: pct(measured.observed.stackLoads - measured.observed.calls, b.fullFrameSteps),
  retiredMatch: measured.observed.retired === b.shadow.steps,
  sregCost: 2*b.shadowCalls,
};
r
